d: A mango has sparked a legal battle between Maharashtra and Gujarat! At the heart of the dispute is Hapus, India's prized Alphonso mango. Maharashtra's Konkan region holds a GI tag for its Alphonso mangoes, but Gujarat wants recognition for its famous Valsad Hapus. While Gujarat argues its farmers deserve a separate identity, Konkan growers fear sharing the Hapus name could dilute their premium brand and hurt their livelihoods. With hundreds of crores at stake, this is more than a fight over a mango. It is a battle over geography, heritage, farmers' rights and the economics of India's…
